content.content: A node-read refusal is produced by the invocation that reads the node — the read or the resolve — and the layer that carried the reason renders nothing.
content.rationale: Only the envelope refuses and failures below it stay values carrying their evidence (S4-own, ouzvzypl; S3-err, uzzxlpsl), so where a node-read failure becomes the invocation's refusal is its own commitment: S2-read-fail says an unreadable document refuses but not where the refusal is produced. The invocation that read the node produces it; the layer that carried the reason renders nothing.
